patch_description: Replace the degenerate all-zero construction with a deterministic, fixed-seed maximin search specialized for the equilateral-triangle domain. The search keeps the three domain vertices, represents the remaining points in simplex coordinates, and uses multi-start simulated annealing with an explicit exhaustive evaluation of all 165 triangle areas. Candidate moves are projected back into the triangle, and the best feasible arrangement encountered is returned. This directly optimizes the primary minimum-area objective while remaining reproducible and handling numerical degeneracy safely.
